items.name: Architecture & System Design
items.description: Modularity, separation of concerns, and clean architectural boundaries
items.learningOutcome: PLO-1: Ability to architect scalable and modular software solutions
items.evidenceGuidance: Inspect C4 diagrams, ADR records, and module boundaries in repo

levels.label: Poor
levels.descriptor: No discernible architectural pattern; tightly coupled components

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.descriptor: Basic layered architecture with minor boundary violations

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Clean modular architecture with well-defined service boundaries

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Exemplary Clean Architecture with decoupled subsystems and ADR documentation

items.name: Testing & Quality Verification
items.description: Automated testing, test coverage, and CI verification
items.learningOutcome: PLO-2: Ability to apply testing techniques ensuring software reliability
items.evidenceGuidance: Inspect unit and integration test suites and CI pipeline execution logs

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.descriptor: Working implementation with limited unit test coverage

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Robust implementation with solid test coverage across scenarios

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Production-grade code with automated unit, integration, and CI/CD pipelines
